Package dayplanner

Class Activity

java.lang.Object
dayplanner.Activity
Direct Known Subclasses:
HomeActivity, OtherActivity, SchoolActivity
public abstract class Activity extends Object
Shared information for every activity in the day planner. Home, school, and other activities inherit the title, start time, end time, and comment stored here.

An activity is valid only when the title is not empty, both times are present, and the start time is strictly before the end time. Subclasses add their own type name and any extra fields.

Version:
2.0

  • Constructor Details

    • Activity

      public Activity(String title, Time startTime, Time endTime, String comment)
      Creates an activity with the fields shared by every activity type.
      Parameters:
      title - activity title; required, and not blank
      startTime - time the activity starts; required
      endTime - time the activity ends; required, and after the start
      comment - optional note; a null comment is stored as an empty string
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the title is blank, a time is missing, or the start time is not before the end time
